alt: Straight Talk Wireless granted a permanent network release for a Motorola Moto G Play 2024 with IMEI ending in 3198, but the device remains restricted by manufacturer-configured secure-boot partitions.
summary: Straight Talk Wireless granted a permanent network release for a Motorola Moto G Play 2024 with IMEI ending in 3198, but the device remains restricted by manufacturer-configured secure-boot partitions.
full_text: Straight Talk Wireless reviewed your unlocking request and confirmed that the Motorola Moto G Play 2024 (IMEI ending in 3198) was granted a permanent network release. The email explains that although the network lock is removed, the device remains restricted by manufacturer‑configured secure‑boot partitions (abl/xbl), which cannot be modified due to regulatory and contractual limitations. The representative attempted to contact you by phone and apologizes for the inconvenience.
